findings.title: Draft names AtliQ Inc, a US-only entity, for a Dubai customer
findings.quote: AtliQ Inc, a Delaware corporation, with its principal office at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, NJ 08540, USA
findings.explanation: The AtliQ entity sheet says AtliQ Inc serves 'Clients in the United States only' and AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd serves the Middle East. TravelHub FZ-LLC is licensed in Dubai Internet City. The tracker note says Nadia (TravelHub) wrote 'we put your US company since you're US-listed on LinkedIn', so the choice came from a LinkedIn listing, not from AtliQ's entity rule. The entity named in a contract decides who invoices, which tax regime applies and which bank account is paid.

findings.title: Hotel-ranking module for UAE and Saudi hotels: possible conflict with the Al Noor restriction, for counsel
findings.quote: a ranking and recommendation service that scores, ranks and surfaces Partner Hotels in the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to TravelHub users at the point of search and itinerary building
findings.explanation: Al Noor §12.1 bars AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd and its Affiliates from providing data analytics, AI or revenue-management services to any 'Hospitality Business' in the GCC, and that definition includes a business that provides distribution services to hotels. TravelHub lists and books hotel inventory under commission agreements (§3.1) and the module ranks those hotels, partly on 'partner commission tier'. Whether TravelHub counts as a Hospitality Business, and whether this module is a service to hotels or only to TravelHub, is not answerable from the text. Naming AtliQ Inc does not remove the question: Al Noor §1.2 and §12.3 reach any entity AtliQ controls, and AtliQ Inc is 100% owned by the Pvt Ltd. The Seaside waiver excludes other Hospitality Businesses and Affiliates. Possible conflict, for counsel.

register_refs.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.

"Hospitality Business" means any person, firm or entity that owns, operates, manages or franchises hotels, resorts or serviced apartments, or that provides distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to any such person, firm or entity.

"Affiliate" means, in relation to a Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that Party, where "control" means the ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting securities of an entity or the power to direct its management and policies, whether by contract or otherwise.
The Supplier shall procure that each of its Affiliates complies with this Clause 12 as if it were a party to this Agreement, and any breach by an Affiliate shall be deemed a breach by the Supplier.

This consent is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW. It does not extend to (a) any other services provided to Seaside, including any extension, renewal, change order or follow-on statement of work, unless separately consented to in writing by the Client; (b) any other Hospitality Business, whether in the Sultanate of Oman or elsewhere in the GCC; or (c) any Affiliate of the Supplier.
